222.title: Thank you Jesus
222.lyrics:
1. Thank you Jesus
Thank You Jesus,
Thank You Lord for loving me.
Thank You Jesus,
Thank You Jesus,
Thank You Lord for loving me.

2. You went to Calvary, there You died for me,
Thank You Lord for loving me (repeat)

3. You rose up from the give, to
me new life You gave,
Thank You Lord for loving me(repeat)

4. You're coming back again, and
we with You shall reign,
Thank You Lord for loving me(repeat)
